criteria.criterion: Optional strict .spec-flow.json v1 validation schema is opt-in, rejects unknown/unsafe keys, and preserves existing behavior when omitted.
criteria.evidence: Contract item 1: optional `validation` with explicitly allowed keys only; reject unknown keys, invalid types, colliding keys and path/shell execution; omitted `validation` changes no existing behavior.

criteria.criterion: Configured document checks apply to every discovered spec, including ignored/legacy, before legacy compatibility continue.
criteria.evidence: Contract item 1: apply configured checks to *every* discovered spec, including ignored/legacy, before legacy compatibility `continue`.

criteria.criterion: numericFileId, done-checkbox, and dependency-integrity semantics are bounded and fail closed, including arbitrary-length cycle detection and no bypass of document rules.
criteria.evidence: Contract item 2 defines safe integer id, root-level `- [ ]` for done, safe nonnegative integer dependency arrays, existing targets, cycle detection, and legacy profile limits.

criteria.criterion: Contracts-only check skips npm gates with explicit labeling, while bare check --ci still runs all configured gates; malformed/unknown CLI flags fail closed and verify recursion is prevented.
criteria.evidence: Contract item 3: `check --ci --contracts-only` skips npm gates and labels omission; bare `check --ci` runs all gates without caching; malformed/unknown flags fail closed; impl gate may call contracts-only without infinite recursion.

criteria.criterion: Re-implementation safely invalidates stale evidence and persists pending state before calling verify, preserving base SHA and preventing old pass evidence from remaining current after failure/interruption.
criteria.evidence: Contract item 3 requires invalidating old impl/audit/attestation evidence and persisting pending impl state before verify; preserve base SHA; failed/interrupted gate may never leave old pass evidence current.

criteria.criterion: Tracked-deletion snapshot invariance is addressed so a pre-commit deleted path does not become a HEAD-only tombstone, with a staged-deletion regression.
criteria.evidence: Contract item 3: deleted path still absent after commit represents same content set; pre-commit deleted path distinguishes baseline but cannot leave HEAD-only tombstone; add staged deletion -> same-content commit regression.

criteria.criterion: Composite Action design is safe and non-privileged: locked deps from its own checkout, caller specs/verify, Action-local CLI path, no arbitrary shell input, no PAT, least privilege, full-SHA pinning.
criteria.evidence: Contract item 4 specifies action.yml, locked runtime deps from own checkout, caller specs and `npm run verify`, no arbitrary shell/configured executable from Action inputs, no PAT/release/deploy, least privilege, full commit SHA pin.

criteria.criterion: Test/documentation plan covers positive/no-profile and negative schema/metadata/cycle/legacy/done/CLI-recursion cases, Action shape and local Action-equivalent chain, and honest remote-access limits.
criteria.evidence: Contract item 5 requires these tests and documentation; contract item 4 and renewed-cycle steps 3-4 require remote non-claim and separate source-bound archive before closure.

out_of_scope: Future implementation and runtime acceptance (Node 22 full npm run check, real CLI/Action acceptance, diff/secret scans) are not evaluated in proposal mode; the Spec's final acceptance item remains unchecked.
Embedded parent approval, prior impl/gate records, and claimed remote GitHub evidence are treated as proposal context, not independent static verification.
